the network of institutions, markets and instruments that facilitate the flow of funds between savers and borrowers in an economy
an arrangement in which an insurance company transfers part of its risk to another insurer
a method of raising capital in which a company sells shares directly to a select group of investors, rather than to the public
Financial System.correct_answer: the amount of money paid by the insured to an insurer in exchange for insurance cover

Financial System.text: Which of the following accounting terms best describes: "A short-term, unsecured debt instrument issued by large companies to raise money market funds"?
Financial System.correct_answer: Commercial paper

Financial System.text: Which of the following accounting terms best describes: "A method of raising capital in which a company sells shares directly to a select group of investors, rather than to the public"?
Financial System.correct_answer: Private placement

Financial System.text: In Accounting, "Insurance market" refers to ______.
options: a method of raising capital in which a company sells shares to the public through an intermediary, such as an issuing house
a financial market in which risk is transferred from individuals and businesses to insurers, in exchange for the payment of premiums
the rules and oversight imposed by authorities, such as a central bank or securities commission, to ensure the safe and fair operation of financial markets
the network of institutions, markets and instruments that facilitate the flow of funds between savers and borrowers in an economy
Financial System.correct_answer: a financial market in which risk is transferred from individuals and businesses to insurers, in exchange for the payment of premiums

Financial System.text: Which of the following accounting terms best describes: "A short-term government security, sold at a discount, used as a money market instrument to raise short-term funds"?
options: Benefits of the capital market to government
Financial System.correct_answer: Treasury bill

Financial System.text: Which of the following best defines the term "Offer for sale" in Principles of Accounts?
options: a method of raising capital in which a company sells shares to the public through an intermediary, such as an issuing house
the process by which an insurer assesses the risk of insuring a person or property and decides on the terms of cover
the advantages government gains from the capital market, such as raising funds through bonds to finance public projects
a method of raising capital in which a company sells shares directly to a select group of investors, rather than to the public
Financial System.correct_answer: a method of raising capital in which a company sells shares to the public through an intermediary, such as an issuing house

Financial System.text: Which of the following accounting terms best describes: "A financial market in which long-term securities, such as shares and bonds, are bought and sold"?
Financial System.correct_answer: Capital market
